_comment: JPL's answer for the main-belt cloud (L-443, Tony's ruling of 2026-10-28, form B). Written 2026-10-28 with Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5, built on orrery b2fcc1bb50d6bbf30fc91ac58de474483a5c7c02. Every orbit JPL's Small-Body Database classes MBA (Main-belt Asteroid) with absolute magnitude H 13 or brighter, as the SBDB Query API returned them on 2026-10-28; the objects' full names are left out to keep the file small, and each is found by its spkid. Values are JPL's strings, unchanged. main_belt_sampler.measure() reads this file and gives the three spread tables in constants_new.py; test_drawings_export.py fails if they differ.
